claim: A classifier built from the 12 measured variables recognises the positive class in new records with an F1 score for the positive class of at least 0.50.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the condition is present in the record

claim: Age explains at least 10% of the variance in liver mass beyond what body mass explains: the increase in R-squared when age is added to a regression of liver mass on body mass is at least 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: liver mass of each rat, in g
age of each rat, in days
body mass of each rat, in g

claim: In 12 anaesthetised dogs, each studied at 8 steps, whole-body oxygen consumption rises with oxygen delivery within a dog, both computed from the measured cardiac output and the arterial and mixed-venous blood oxygen contents by the standard Fick definitions: the mean over dogs of the within-dog regression slope of oxygen consumption on oxygen delivery is at least 0.15 (mL O2 per min per mL O2 per min).

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output of each dog at each step, in L per min
a second, independent determination of the cardiac output of each dog at each step, in L per min
arterial blood oxygen content of each dog at each step, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each dog at each step, in mL O2 per dL

claim: Forty participants, 20 young and 20 old, completed a training programme, and a performance score was recorded before and after it. Claim: the mean improvement (after minus before) is larger in young than in old participants, judged by a one-sided test of the difference between the two groups' mean improvements at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: performance score before the programme
performance score after the programme
True for young participants, False for old participants

claim: Across children, BMI at baseline and the subsequent change in BMI are negatively correlated: the correlation between the BMI level at baseline and the change in BMI by follow-up is at most -0.25.

data_keys.meaning: BMI of each child at the baseline visit, in kg/m2
a second BMI measurement of each child at the baseline visit, in kg/m2
BMI of each child at the follow-up visit five years after baseline, in kg/m2

claim: Gene-expression features discriminate cases from controls in new subjects: the area under the ROC curve of a linear classifier (ridge regression on the diagnosis coded as plus or minus one, penalty 10 on standardised features) that uses 20 of the 1000 expression features to recover the diagnosis y is at least 0.65.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each of 1000 genes for each subject
True where the subject has the diagnosis, False for a control

claim: The daily predictors X carry information about the daily outcome y on future days: the Pearson correlation between y and the prediction of a ridge regression of y on X (penalty 1.0 on standardised predictors, with an intercept), computed over future days, is at least 0.20.

data_keys.meaning: 6 continuous daily predictor series, one value per predictor per day
continuous daily outcome

claim: Among 3 groups of 25 rats each, mean resting oxygen uptake differs between the groups once body mass is accounted for: the analysis-of-covariance F test of the group effect on oxygen uptake, with body mass as the covariate, has a p-value below 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: resting oxygen uptake of each rat in each group, in mL O2 per min
body mass of each rat in each group, in g

claim: In 24 intrabony periodontal defects treated by guided tissue regeneration, the level of disease explains the amount of change: the mean of the baseline and follow-up pocket probing depth explains at least 15% of the variance in the change in pocket probing depth (follow-up minus baseline), that is, the R-squared of the linear regression of the change on that mean is at least 0.15.

data_keys.meaning: pocket probing depth of each defect at the baseline examination, in mm
a second, independent probing of the depth of each defect at the baseline examination, in mm
pocket probing depth of each defect at the follow-up examination after treatment, in mm

claim: Features computed from wearable-sensor signals recognise walking in newly recruited subjects: the classification error rate for walking versus other activities is at most 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: features computed from the sensor signal in each time window of each subject
True if the subject was walking during the window

claim: The monthly environmental measurements predict the abundance in later months of the series: the out-of-sample R-squared is at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: monthly abundance index of the species, on a log scale, in time order
monthly environmental measurements, in time order

claim: The 500 features in X predict the outcome y for new samples: the R-squared of a ridge-penalised linear regression of y that uses 20 of the 500 features (penalty 10 on standardised features, with an intercept) is at least 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: 500 continuous imaging-derived features for each sample
continuous symptom score of each sample
